topic: An old phone retired to the drawer.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Retired Phone

shots.narration: I used to run your life. Now I live beside lint.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, inside a wooden bedside drawer with tangled cables and lint, no text or markings.
shots.action: An old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small mouth on its blank screen brushes lint from its face.
shots.mood: Cosy amber light, dusty surroundings, indignant expression.

shots.narration: My retirement party was you buying a shinier rectangle.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, modern bedroom nightstand beside an open drawer, a sleek new phone resting above, no text or markings.
shots.action: A human hand lowers the old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small frowning mouth into the drawer.
shots.mood: Bright morning light, wounded dignity, cheerful room.

shots.narration: [sighs] Apparently, keeping me means never touching me again.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, view from inside the wooden drawer, old phone resting among cables, no text or markings.
shots.action: The drawer slides shut above the old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small worried mouth.
shots.mood: Narrowing stripe of daylight, comically dramatic shadows.

shots.narration: Then, daylight! Finally, someone remembered my years of service.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, open bedside drawer in a sunny modern bedroom, no text or markings.
shots.action: The old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small delighted mouth rises in a human hand.
shots.mood: Golden daylight, hopeful expression, triumphant atmosphere.

shots.narration: They needed a cable. I was sitting on it.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, bedside drawer containing the old phone and a loose charging cable, no text or markings.
shots.action: A human hand pulls the cable from beneath the old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small disappointed mouth.
shots.mood: Bright domestic light, painfully awkward disappointment.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] Great news: I've been promoted to cable paperweight.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, wooden drawer interior with loosely coiled spare cables, no text or markings.
shots.action: The old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small flat mouth settles onto a coil of cables.

shots.narration: Wait. The remote's missing. I can control the television!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, open drawer beside a living room with displaced couch cushions and a dark television, no text or markings.
shots.action: The old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small eager mouth lights up its screen around its face.
shots.mood: Hopeful blue glow, messy cosy living room.

shots.narration: They brought me back! Straight onto the couch.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, soft colourful couch facing a television in a cosy living room, no text or markings.
shots.action: A human hand places the old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small proud smile beside a couch cushion.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Found the remote. Apparently, we're both retired under this cushion.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, narrow gap beneath couch cushions, a plain remote with blank buttons resting below, no text or markings.
shots.action: The old rounded phone with big expressive eyes and a small astonished mouth slides into the cushion gap beside the remote.
shots.mood: Soft shadowy hiding place, absurd reunion, playful defeat.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the remote explains its suspicious relationship with couch cushions.
episode.description: An old phone discovers that retirement means being forgotten in a drawer full of tangled cables. But one missing remote might bring it back into action.
